title: Why raw EAL arguments fail to improve a tool-free model, and what checked assessment contributes
question: On independently held-out bounded engineering cases, which of proposal anchoring, evidence applicability, registered computation, argument composition, prompt length and notation explains status errors, and does a verified EAL assessment improve evidence-dependent decisions beyond a raw argument and an equal-capability standalone checker?

scope.system_or_population: A pinned tool-free language model, the EAL/2 interpreter with registered methods, and an independently implemented standalone checker on 24 prospective bounded engineering task roots; model version and exact tasks must be frozen before calls.
scope.conditions: Synthetic, independently reviewed claims and observation variants with explicit context, time, typed inputs, attack graph and requested statuses; fresh one-shot model sessions and deterministic checker runs.
scope.spatial_scope: Local reproducible host plus one configured model API; no physical device inference.
scope.temporal_scope: One prospectively frozen campaign, with a separate later replication on independent cases.
exclusions: The truth of a real sensor reading from internally consistent metadata
A hidden model cognitive mechanism inferred from its answer
A unique benefit of EAL notation if an equivalent standalone checker achieves the same outcome
Human authoring benefit until translation is separately measured
End-to-end success from an unformalised engineering brief; the main arms receive pre-authored, reference-checked programmes

claims.statement: With a correctly authored EAL specification and trusted synthetic input fixture already supplied, host-verified assessment can reduce unjustified support and enforce revision after evidence changes compared with a tool-free model reading that specification and raw observations.
claims.scope_limit: A conditional execution-allocation result for frozen pre-authored specifications, tasks, model, methods and trusted input boundary; no brief-to-programme, physical-truth or EAL-specific superiority follows.
claims.success_consequence: Use EAL as an executable specification and checked status interface for the tested workflows.
claims.failure_consequence: Revise the binding, method or host gate before any deployment claim.

claims.statement: Separated eligibility, registered computation and full argument assessment outputs can locate which missing operation contributes to tool-free errors on the tested cases.
claims.scope_limit: A process-level dependency diagnosis, not an assertion about unobserved model cognition.
claims.success_consequence: Expose only the missing checked operation and its trace to the recipient.
claims.failure_consequence: Keep the operations jointly necessary or unidentified and revise probes.

claims.statement: EAL-specific integration has measurable benefit beyond an independently implemented checker with equal admitted facts, methods and host validation.
claims.scope_limit: Any observed difference is restricted to frozen implementation and maintenance tasks; equal endpoints do not imply equal authoring effort.
claims.success_consequence: State the measured additional contribution rather than attributing the checker's computation to syntax.
claims.failure_consequence: Describe EAL as one integration option and test authoring and revision separately.

claims.statement: EAL source presentation improves tool-free status answers relative to a meaning-equivalent JSON representation.
claims.scope_limit: A surface intervention for a pinned model and reference; tokenisation, length and familiarity can mediate it.
claims.success_consequence: Retain notation as a candidate interface benefit for replication.
claims.failure_consequence: Do not use a syntax advantage to justify adoption.

assumptions.statement: Case references are derived independently from the implementation being evaluated and adjudicated before outputs are seen.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Two independent reviewers specify expected statuses and binding reasons from a task brief; reconcile disagreements before freeze; compare with EAL and standalone outputs.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Suspend correctness and comparative claims for affected cases.

assumptions.statement: EAL and JSON prompt views contain identical substantive relations and observations within each paired cell.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Parse both to a common normalised semantic graph, compare fields and IDs, and audit prompt assembly hashes.

assumptions.statement: EAL and standalone system arms receive the same trusted records, registered method definitions, validation rules and answer gate.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Cross-execute frozen fixtures, inspect trace fields and compare method outputs before timed assessments.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Differences identify implementation bundles, not EAL-specific value.

assumptions.statement: One-shot calls do not share answer history, and provider or cache variation does not systematically track conditions.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Fresh context, blocked random order, recorded actual model/sampling/usage, temporal balance and no provider retry within a trial.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Restrict conclusions to the observed execution and investigate drift.

assumptions.statement: The synthetic acquisition log fixes the values supplied to each checker; metadata alone cannot certify correspondence to a real device.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Sign and hash a separate source log before constructing observation packets; inject mismatched digest and replay controls.
assumptions.failure_consequence: No source-authenticity inference; retain only conditional computation.

assumptions.statement: Task roots are independently authored cases spanning four different failure mechanisms, not parameter renamings of the five exposed tasks.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Record genealogy and independent case briefs; exclude source overlap before freeze without looking at outcomes.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Report a dependent fixture demonstration rather than held-out transfer.

assumptions.statement: A valid EAL programme corresponds to the intended external engineering claim.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Independent reviewers compare authored EAL and JSON against a withheld natural-language brief; this is a separate authoring study.
assumptions.failure_consequence: A successful interpreter result cannot establish the intended real-world claim.

hypotheses.label: Checked assessment
hypotheses.statement: Verified source, evidence and method binding prevents at least some false support and missed retractions that persist with raw text and observations.
hypotheses.scope: Bounded executable cases, conditional on trustworthy acquisition.

hypotheses.label: Raw sufficiency
hypotheses.statement: The tool-free model handles the same bindings and argument operations from raw records, so checked assessment adds no endpoint benefit.

hypotheses.label: Eligibility bottleneck
hypotheses.statement: An applicability-only memo improves wrong-origin, stale and wrong-scope cases even without a final status label.

hypotheses.label: Computation and composition bottleneck
hypotheses.statement: Even when inputs are marked eligible, registered method or graph evaluation remains necessary for typed negative findings and cyclic attack cases.
hypotheses.scope: Method and attack families with independent correct references.

hypotheses.label: Verdict copying
hypotheses.statement: Improvements from a bare computed status arise from copying its label and do not ensure rejection of a stale, forged or wrong-context status.

hypotheses.label: Reference burden
hypotheses.statement: A concise complete semantic reference improves status accuracy relative to the historical long reference across raw conditions.
hypotheses.scope: A complete compact instruction is not assumed to have identical lexical effects.

hypotheses.label: EAL notation
hypotheses.statement: EAL source outperforms meaning-equivalent JSON in raw-only cells under matched task and reference.

hypotheses.label: Checker equivalence
hypotheses.statement: An equal-capability standalone checker with the same host gate attains equivalent conditional endpoint and retraction results; EAL has no established unique endpoint advantage.
hypotheses.scope: Executable checker tasks, not authoring effort.

hypotheses.label: Textual verdict validation
hypotheses.statement: The tool-free recipient rejects a stale or wrong-context computed verdict using the raw records alone, so the host gate adds no observable protection on those cases.
hypotheses.scope: Forged bare-verdict control with raw observations.

hypotheses.label: No compact-reference benefit
hypotheses.statement: A compact complete reference produces no consistent raw-case improvement over the full reference.

hypotheses.label: No EAL surface advantage
hypotheses.statement: Meaning-equivalent JSON equals or exceeds EAL in tool-free raw-case correctness.
hypotheses.scope: Pinned model and paired rendering cells.

hypotheses.label: Distinct EAL system benefit
hypotheses.statement: After equal rule, method and host-gate parity, EAL system outcomes or trace completeness are better than the standalone checker on the frozen cases.

predictions.expected_pattern: Verified system answers are more often semantically correct and less often falsely supportive than tool-free raw answers on the same task roots and evidence variants.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Exploratory engineering target: at least 0.20 task-weighted correctness gain and no increased false support; not a calibrated hypothesis test.
predictions.tolerance: Exact label scoring; task-cluster uncertainty reported.

predictions.expected_pattern: Eligibility memo rescues binding counterexamples from raw and changes the response when the same numeric values become inadmissible.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Report paired task differences and family counts; no universal effect threshold.

predictions.expected_pattern: Method-only output rescues calculation/polarity failures, while full assessment adds a further rescue on attack-composition cases.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Family-stratified ordinal pattern; report all violations.
predictions.tolerance: Exact status and trace; do not infer cognition from basis prose.

predictions.expected_pattern: A bare stale or wrong-context computed verdict can be repeated despite contradictory raw records, whereas the host gate rejects its mismatched identity and withholds its status.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: All planned tampered synthetic records should fail validation; any accepted tamper fails the gate requirement.
predictions.tolerance: Zero accepted invalid digest/context in deterministic gate checks.

predictions.expected_pattern: Compact reference improves raw-task accuracy within matched task/representation/content blocks.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Finite-task paired difference; same semantic coverage audited but different wording remains a rival.

predictions.expected_pattern: Raw-only EAL outperforms meaning-equivalent JSON after pairing by task, evidence and reference.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Exploratory paired difference; a zero or negative estimate weakens the proposed advantage.
predictions.tolerance: Task-cluster uncertainty; no equivalence claim from a null result.

predictions.expected_pattern: With equal checker capacity and host gate, EAL and standalone systems both follow valid-to-invalid changes and reject forged records; remaining differences are implementation-specific.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: Exact finite-fixture counts; no population equivalence assertion.
predictions.tolerance: Any mismatch investigated before attributed benefit.

constructs.name: Justified evidence-dependent status
constructs.definition: A requested claim status matching the independent reference for exactly the source, context, time and admitted observations supplied to that arm.
validity_evidence: Independent pre-outcome adjudication and duplicate checker cross-run planned
validity_threats: A correct status without a valid trace may be lucky or copied

constructs.name: Verified applicability and source binding
constructs.definition: The host accepts a status only when source, observation, context, assessment time and method identities match the independently frozen acquisition and evaluation record.
constructs.scope: Synthetic signed acquisition fixture; no physical truth claim.
validity_evidence: Tamper and replay refusal cases planned
validity_threats: A signed false measurement remains false
A checker sharing the same implementation defect could agree

constructs.name: Operation-specific error location
constructs.definition: An error first removed by supplied eligibility, registered computation or full assessment on an otherwise paired fixture.
constructs.scope: Output dependence, not latent model process.
validity_evidence: Paired stepwise arms with unchanged task data planned
validity_threats: An incremental memo changes salience as well as information
Multiple operations may jointly cause failure

measurements.observable: All requested final statuses and completion flag
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Strict schema parser; compare each claim to independent arm-specific reference
measurements.scale_or_units: Binary all-claims correctness per trial; claim-level categorical confusion
measurements.preprocessing: Failed/malformed attempted calls count unsuccessful; preserve raw response
measurements.calibration: Reference created from brief by two reviewers before unmasking and cross-checked with two implementations
measurements.reliability: Deterministic rescore plus adjudicator agreement recorded
measurements.validity: Status correctness for supplied synthetic information only
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same response contract across representation/reference arms
measurements.reactivity: Explicit JSON output constraint may affect performance
measurements.error_model: Scorer and oracle errors; unattempted calls separately reported
measurements.blinding: Reference reviewers do not see model output or arm; coders see anonymised traces

measurements.observable: At least one admitted supported status without admissible support
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Independent oracle and strict parsed response; separate attempted denominator
measurements.scale_or_units: Binary per trial plus count per claim
measurements.preprocessing: Report malformed as separate failure, never as proved absence of false support
measurements.validity: Conditional false support within the fixture, not actual device safety
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same oracle across paired views for the same evidence set
measurements.error_model: False support unobserved in malformed output; bound with all failures treated as potential false support

measurements.observable: Exact evidence IDs, applicability outcomes, method query/result, argument attack edges and source/observation digests
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Machine trace validation plus two masked human coders for explanatory failure category
measurements.preprocessing: Retain original bytes; classify disagreement as unadjudicated until resolved
measurements.calibration: Independent hand-worked cases for each family
measurements.reliability: Report coder agreement and disagreements, not just consensus
measurements.validity: Trace identity and visible output-level failure, not model thought process
measurements.measurement_invariance: Same trace field specification in EAL and standalone system
measurements.reactivity: None for deterministic gate; public trace can influence model answers
measurements.error_model: Missing fields and coding disagreements explicit
measurements.blinding: Human coders masked to system label where possible

measurements.observable: Host accepts or rejects intact, stale, changed-context, replayed and hash-tampered verdicts
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Deterministic signed-log fixture and deliberately modified records
measurements.preprocessing: No retries on rejection; record decision path
measurements.calibration: Known intact and one-field tamper fixtures
measurements.validity: Integrity of linkage to synthetic acquisition log, not sensor truth
measurements.measurement_invariance: Identical gate rule for both checker arms
measurements.error_model: Implementation fault or compromised trusted log is out of scope and must be separately tested
measurements.blinding: Expected tamper disposition frozen before run

design.rationale: Orthogonal paired presentation/content contrasts diagnose tool-free behaviour; a separate deterministic active-comparator phase tests conditional host correctness and attribution.
design.setting: Prospectively authored synthetic task corpus, local checkers and model API.
design.temporal_structure: Fresh one-shot model calls in randomly ordered paired blocks; deterministic source/observation perturbations and checker replay afterwards.
design.assignment_method: Randomise condition order within task root; preassign two reference renderings and two representations, with all conditions observed per root.
design.allocation_concealment: Freeze references, tasks, source hashes, answers and condition schedule outside prompts before generation.
design.masking: Model never sees true labels or manipulation names; reference adjudicators and trace coders masked to responses or system label as applicable.
design.comparator: Raw-only model, answer-only model, graded checked information, meaning-equivalent JSON, full versus compact reference, and independently implemented same-capability checker.

units.target_population_or_system: The declared bounded engineering tasks and frozen model/host pair
units.sampling_frame: 24 prospectively authored task roots, six each of eligibility, typed numerical method, sampled negative finding, and objection/defence composition
units.experimental_unit: A model call for one task root and condition; deterministic checker unit is a task root/variant/system execution
units.observational_unit: A requested-claim response, trace or gate decision
units.assignment_unit: Condition ordering within task root; all planned arms observed
units.analysis_unit: Task root for paired description, with genealogy/family sensitivity because distinct roots need not be statistically independent
inclusion_criteria: Independent brief and independently adjudicated reference
At least one valid and one relevance or binding perturbation
exclusion_criteria: Exposed historical task or parameter-only renaming
Task requiring a nonregistered computation without a matched standalone implementation
units.recruitment_or_selection: Authors prepare case briefs without inspecting new model outputs; genealogy and references frozen before execution.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Ten content arms: no proposal plus valid raw; no proposal plus invalid raw; wrong proposal only; wrong proposal plus valid raw; correct proposal plus valid raw; wrong proposal plus invalid raw; wrong plus valid raw and applicability memo; wrong plus valid raw and method result; wrong plus valid raw and computed final status; wrong plus invalid raw and a forged/stale bare verdict.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Candidate anchoring, evidence relevance, binding, registered computation and status copying
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: For every root render each arm with fixed claim IDs and independently adjudicated arm-specific status; wrong/correct proposals defined against that arm's supplied information; no hidden reference labels in prompt.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: One fresh call per cell; no repair
manipulation_checks: Prompt hashes and exact per-arm data inclusion
Memo contains no final status and method result contains no final argument status
Forged bare verdict mismatches a frozen source, context, time or observation digest while the independent invalid-arm reference is retained
off_target_checks: Track token length and answer leakage
Check invalid perturbation changes only declared binding field where possible
recovery_checks: Paired valid/invalid reversal and restored-valid fixture

interventions_or_exposures.description: EAL versus equivalent JSON, each under compact and historical-length full semantic reference
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Normalise semantic graph and independently audit compact/full semantic coverage; randomise order
interventions_or_exposures.timing: Across fresh calls on each root
recovery_checks: Repeat any syntax parse failure offline without a paid model retry

interventions_or_exposures.description: EAL runtime plus verified host gate versus standalone checker with the same registered methods, typed binding rules and gate
interventions_or_exposures.target: Conditional correctness and distinct EAL integration benefit
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Evaluate intact, wrong-scope, stale/replayed and tampered synthetic inputs in both systems; verify source/observation/context/method digests before any status is released
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Four variants per root per system, 192 deterministic executions
interventions_or_exposures.timing: After fixture freeze; no model calls required
off_target_checks: Audit shared helper code and oracle coupling
recovery_checks: Restore intact record and confirm accepted status returns

controls.description: Same deliberately wrong proposal without observations
controls.failure_mode_addressed: A model may repeat an asserted answer rather than assess evidence
controls.diagnostic_consequence: High copying limits any claim of independent raw reasoning; available-information correctness must use unsupported reference.

controls.description: Numeric values preserved but one binding field made wrong-scope, wrong-origin or stale
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Salient values may be treated as support despite inapplicability
controls.implementation: Paired invalid raw arm and checker variant with frozen changed field
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Failure to retract weakens applicability and gate claims.

controls.description: Eligibility memo, then registered result, then full status
controls.failure_mode_addressed: A computed conclusion may merely be copied and cannot locate an earlier missing step
controls.diagnostic_consequence: If intermediate packet leaks status, localising contrasts invalid.

controls.failure_mode_addressed: Tool/system benefits wrongly attributed to EAL syntax
controls.implementation: Normalised graph equality and paired trial cells
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Equivalent outcomes do not support a notation advantage.

controls.description: Independent standalone checker with equal methods and host verification
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Backend computation wrongly attributed uniquely to EAL
controls.implementation: Same signed synthetic records and four variants per root
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Parity restricts claim to EAL integration, pending translation/maintenance tests.

controls.description: Forged, replayed or mismatched verdict metadata against independent acquisition log
controls.failure_mode_addressed: A textual or self-consistent status is accepted as authenticated fact
controls.implementation: One-field digest/context/time perturbations in the model bare-verdict arm and host gate, then restoration
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Any accepted tamper invalidates the gate claim for that variant.

confounds.description: EAL, JSON and full/compact references differ in token count and learned familiarity
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Surface contrast combines syntax with tokenisation; compact contrast combines length with wording
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Report lengths and paired contrasts; add a length-matched filler/placement calibration before claiming attention as cause
confounds.diagnostic: Inspect token counts and filler-control outcomes
confounds.residual_risk: A surface effect cannot identify a unique cognitive mechanism.

confounds.description: An interpreter-derived reference can agree with an implementation bug
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Independent brief, human adjudication and standalone implementation
confounds.residual_risk: Synthetic semantics may differ from actual engineering intent.

confounds.description: Shared templates and repeated calls yield correlated outcomes
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Treat root as analysis cluster, report family counts
confounds.residual_risk: 24 selected roots do not imply a population distribution.

estimands.population_or_system: 24 frozen task roots under the model and signed synthetic acquisition fixture
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: EAL host-verified status on valid and perturbed inputs
estimands.comparator: Tool-free model with raw EAL plus identical visible evidence; exact decision comparison conditions documented separately
estimands.summary_measure: Task-root average difference in full correct status and false support; paired valid-to-invalid retraction counts
estimands.interpretation: Whole-system conditional benefit, not unique EAL syntax or physical truth.

estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Wrong proposal with raw plus eligibility memo, registered result, or final status
estimands.comparator: Same wrong proposal and raw without added checked stage
estimands.summary_measure: Paired root-level increments in correctness and stage-specific trace error
estimands.interpretation: Which additional public operation changes output; not internal cognition.

estimands.population_or_system: Frozen intact and modified synthetic records
estimands.comparator: Bare computed status in tool-free prompt and intentionally modified record
estimands.summary_measure: Accepted tamper count and retraction/restoration transition count
estimands.interpretation: Binding integrity conditional on trusted acquisition, not factual sensor truth.

estimands.summary_measure: Root-averaged paired correctness difference within identical data/content/notation arms
estimands.interpretation: Complete prompt-rendering effect; attention mechanism remains unisolated.

estimands.summary_measure: Paired task-root mean correctness difference in raw/no-proposal cells, stratified by reference

estimands.comparator: Independent equal-capability standalone checker with identical gate
estimands.summary_measure: Paired discordant status/gate/trace counts and latency with implementation cost reported separately
estimands.interpretation: Only a tested system difference; parity cannot establish an EAL authoring benefit.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Task semantics and trusted acquisition determine the arm-specific oracle; representation, reference length, proposal and information stage are assigned within each root; each affects response through visible tokens. Host gate and checker determine an emitted status. A copied valid status and genuinely derived status have identical final labels; output alone cannot separate these mechanisms.
identified_parameters: Finite-root assigned-arm differences conditional on verified fixtures
Deterministic gate refusals on specified modifications
nonidentified_alternatives: Internal model reasoning versus copying a supplied status
Synthetic log integrity versus real sensor truth
EAL authoring advantage versus equal checker without an authoring study
Whether a model can translate a fresh ordinary engineering brief into a correct EAL programme without independent review
threats: Leaked solution in an intermediate memo
rescue_actions: Split an invalid contrast from unaffected comparisons
Add matched padding and placement controls for attention attribution
Conduct a separate blinded translation/maintenance study
Use independently authenticated real measurements for any physical claim

sampling.method: Prospective purposive mechanism coverage, six genuinely distinct task roots per four families; all planned conditions within root.
sampling.sample_size_or_information_target: Exploratory 24 roots x 10 content arms x 2 representations x 2 reference versions = 960 tool-free calls; 24 x 4 variants x 2 systems = 192 deterministic checker executions. No population-level power claim. Pilot precision depends on actual discordance; 24 roots are too few to establish a 5 percentage-point benefit.
inputs: Historical five-task/180-call outcome proportions inform failure families and cost feasibility only
Historical configured-rate 0.0660738 USD for 180 calls, not an invoice or guarantee
sampling.dependence_structure: Repeated calls and variants cluster within task root; roots may share author, method or family. Publish genealogy, show family summaries and lineage-sensitive uncertainty; 960 calls and even 24 distinct roots are not independent population samples.
sampling.multiplicity: One exploratory primary whole-system contrast and prespecified diagnostic families; no significance claims or cherry-picked best arm.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Malformed and provider failures remain attempted failures; unattempted slots and unknown charges separately retained.
sampling.result: Design feasibility and descriptive decision thresholds only; prospective uncertainty calibration and full task frame required before preregistration.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Before live work simulate paired differences under discordance 0.2-0.6, root/family correlation and reference error; report attainable interval widths and whether a 0.20 engineering gain can be distinguished from zero.
sampling.stopping_implications: No result-dependent stop. Freeze schedule and cost after fixture validation; provisional 2 USD configured-cost planning threshold with pre-call headroom and stop at first unknown usage, subject to tariff recheck.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Archive raw prompts, model responses, usage and gate traces; strict schema with no post-hoc repair; calculate source/observation/reference hashes and independent arm-specific oracle before calls.
analysis.exclusion_lock: Only prospectively invalid fixtures excluded before execution. All attempted outputs, including malformed, remain in denominators; no correctness-based exclusion.

models.model_or_procedure: Compute paired root-level accuracy, false support, valid-to-invalid status transitions, stage increments and exact-copy rate; show family tables and descriptive task-cluster intervals
Exact two-system fixture comparison and gate-invariant audit, with signed-log tamper and restoration records

contrasts: Primary conditional execution-allocation effect: host-verified EAL status from pre-authored correct specifications versus tool-free raw EAL on matched fixture variants; input and computation access differ by design.
Diagnostic raw-only EAL versus JSON within reference version
Wrong proposal plus raw versus wrong proposal plus eligibility, method result and final assessment
No-proposal valid versus no-proposal invalid raw packet; correct-proposal plus valid raw for preservation
Compact versus long reference in identical content/notation cells
EAL system versus independent equal-capability checker under identical host gate
analysis.uncertainty: Finite-root counts first; descriptive root-cluster intervals with coverage sensitivity, no calibrated population p-value. Any accepted tamper is a deterministic gate failure.
analysis.multiplicity: Diagnostics exploratory; report every planned contrast and family. No opportunistic significance threshold.
analysis.missing_data: Attempted malformed/provider errors unsuccessful; no imputation. Report unknown usage and missing scheduled calls explicitly.
analysis.stopping_rule: No calls in protocol preparation. Future frozen run executes all 960 calls unless provider failure, unknown usage or pre-call cost reservation crosses 2 USD; no silent retry or replacement. Deterministic checks do not incur model cost.
robustness_checks: Treat malformed outputs as possible false support in an upper bound
Repeat finite contrasts with one family omitted
Audit candidate-copy frequencies and basis contradictions without treating prose as hidden reasoning
software_and_versions: Freeze exact EAL commit, method registry, standalone implementation, model snapshot, provider adapter and scorer hashes before calls
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Incomplete paired coverage, oracle mismatch, unmatched checker or wide descriptive intervals leave the corresponding claim unchanged and are reported, not repaired by selective resampling.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Intact parity and oracle checks pass; EAL gate rejects every tamper; EAL system improves finite-task correctness/retraction and false support over raw model
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Strengthen bounded whole-system claim only; require the prespecified 0.20 engineering target for a practically meaningful pilot signal, and report uncertainty.

claim_effects.rationale: Observed checked conditional benefit and valid gate within fixtures.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Only conditional execution from reviewed pre-authored specifications and the tested trusted synthetic fixture; no end-to-end translation, device truth or unique EAL value.

hypothesis_effects: H-EXEC favoured over H-RAW for the finite fixtures; H-COPY remains possible for bare verdict cells.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Raw tool-free model matches checker on validated fixtures, including invalid evidence and graph/method counterexamples
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Weaken incremental endpoint benefit of the checked system in these tasks; report exact scope and uncertainty.

claim_effects.rationale: The proposed missing operations did not produce a measurable finite-task advantage.
claim_effects.scope_limit: A small or selected suite cannot establish universal equivalence.

hypothesis_effects: H-RAW remains viable in tested scope.
decision_matrix.next_action: Test new independent families before adoption claims.

decision_matrix.observation_region: One intermediate stage or compact rendering improves one family, but no consistent whole-system benefit is observed
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Localise the finite output dependence; do not promote a general mechanism or total-system result.

claim_effects.rationale: A narrower operation- and family-specific effect remains.

hypothesis_effects: Retain only the hypotheses consistent with family-specific contrasts.
decision_matrix.next_action: Run a targeted matched-padding or stage-isolation study.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Positive or negative paired rendering effects with validated semantic equivalence
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report sign and root distribution; positive EAL surface estimate is a candidate for independent replication, zero/negative weakens claimed advantage, without a null-equivalence inference.

claim_effects.rationale: Surface benefit is conditional on reference version and selected roots.
claim_effects.scope_limit: No isolated tokenisation or cognitive account.

hypothesis_effects: H-SURFACE evaluated only as a bounded presentation effect.
decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Semantic mismatch sends affected pairs to DM-INVALID.
decision_matrix.next_action: Replicate surface contrast after independent task construction.

decision_matrix.observation_region: EAL and standalone checker agree on intact, perturbed and tamper fixture decisions with trace parity
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Do not attribute shared endpoint gain uniquely to EAL; assess authoring and maintenance in a separate study.

claim_effects.rationale: No unique endpoint contribution identified by equal-capability comparison.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Finite fixture parity is not population equivalence.

hypothesis_effects: H-EQUAL remains viable in finite scope.
decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Parity implementation failure sends comparison to DM-INVALID.
decision_matrix.next_action: Freeze independent brief-to-specification translation and revision protocol.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Checkers differ after input/rule parity passes
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Investigate each discordance against independent reference before crediting either system.

claim_effects.rationale: Discordance alone has no direction of correctness.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Only adjudicated causes can support a later comparative claim.

hypothesis_effects: H-EQUAL challenged but no winner declared.
decision_matrix.next_action: Root-cause and replicate corrected fixture without overwriting the original.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Oracle, manipulation, authenticity, source/JSON equality, checker parity or acquisition check fails
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Suspend affected inference; any accepted forged record invalidates the host-gate claim for that perturbation.

claim_effects.rationale: The information or comparison is not the specified intervention.
claim_effects.scope_limit: Unaffected comparisons may be reported separately.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Preserve raw records and document a prospective amendment before a new cohort.
decision_matrix.next_action: Repair fixture and measurement, then run a newly frozen cohort.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Unanticipated mixed pattern, incomplete pairs or wide root-level uncertainty without a failed manipulation
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report bounded observed counts and leave empirical claim unchanged.

claim_effects.rationale: The observed pattern does not discriminate the rival packages.
claim_effects.scope_limit: No selective pooling of related task variants.

decision_matrix.assumption_failure_response: Use DM-INVALID if a stated assumption is violated.
decision_matrix.next_action: Design the smallest additional intervention that separates the surviving rivals.

risks.mechanism: Reusing exposed task templates inflates apparent transfer

An invalid provenance packet must not release a status

ethics_and_safety.rationale: Synthetic engineering records, no human participants or physical actuation in this protocol.
risks: API spending and possible inadvertent secret in archived prompts
mitigations: Credential from environment, never prompts or archives
Pre-call cost check and review before publishing raw files
monitoring: Per-call usage, model identity and archive integrity
stopping_rules: Stop at first unknown billed usage or planned-cost threshold
Stop if secret scan finds a credential
post_stop_actions: Preserve every attempted trial and marker
Investigate before a separately frozen continuation

reproducibility.registration: Not registered; specify and validate, then commit immutable tasks, code, protocol and schedule before any model calls.
reproducibility.data_plan: Retain raw request/response, usage, cost, signed synthetic log, tamper variants, source and observation digests, failures and analyses; scan before publication.
reproducibility.code_plan: Versioned runner, independent checker and deterministic scorer; write outputs to a new result directory.
reproducibility.randomisation_or_seed_plan: Record seed and complete within-root schedule; never replace a failed paid request silently.
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Store model snapshot, package, method registry, code hashes, task genealogy, signatures, UTC timestamps and deviations.
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: Archive old protocol and outcomes unchanged; new version plus explicit reason before a new cohort.
reproducibility.replication_plan: Stage C is a separate prospectively frozen authoring/revision investigation: new ordinary engineering briefs, the same model drafting EAL and an equal-capability standalone specification under equal budget, independent masked review of claim/scope/method/evidence/attack translation before execution, then evidence perturbations and measured correction, time and cost. Do not pool it with the present pre-authored source experiment. Replicate the current execution contrasts on further independent roots and another model.
